targets.relevance_reason: Invalid.__deepcopy__ (23–24) declares self, memo, other and is annotated with the expected unexpected-special-method-signature diagnostic. It is the exact violating hook in the question.

Valid.__deepcopy__ (90–91) takes only self and memo, providing the directly corresponding valid protocol shape. Valid and invalid fixture entrances share one example group, so both do not add independent nDCG credit.

SpecialMethodsChecker._check_unexpected_method_signature (197–245) reads SPECIAL_METHODS_PARAMS, removes self for ordinary methods, counts mandatory/optional arguments, and emits when the required signature cannot be met. utils.py places __deepcopy__ in the one-parameter set (116–179), so an extra required other argument triggers the checker.
